messages:
Ravi: heads-up: we plan a base-image rebuild Tues to tighten runtime sec and add cosign signing via KMS. Need RBAC + audit retention confirmed.
Maya: staging + canary first. prod after canary passes.
Tom: prefer per-env KMS keys. pipeline SA gets SignOnly role. no decrypt.
Ravi: agree. create secrets in `image-signing` ns and limit with resourceNames. admission should only allow secrets labeled `cosign=true`.
Maya: logging: security wants 270d for sign events and 365d for push events. fields: env, key_id, job_id, digest. no user emails.
build-bot: PIPELINE(images/cosign): canary build scheduled 2026-05-10T03:00Z. artifact digest: sha256:abcd1234.
Tom: vuln triage: openssl CVE-2025-4455 must be patched before prod. Add trivy gate in CI: fail on HIGH/CRITICAL.
Maya: incident flow: revoke KMS key, blacklist digest, push hotfix, update admission fallback. infra owns blacklist API.
Ravi: owners + ETAs: Tom: create RBAC PR + admission check (48h). Maya: trivy gating + CI changes (24h). Tom: stub blacklist endpoint (72h).
Maya: legal confirm: signing metadata not PII. log by job_id only.
Ravi: will publish coordination doc and invite owners. ping here if blockers. :thumbsup:
